title: Umm Ayman
tagline: Barakah from Abyssinia looked after the Prophet ﷺ from the day he was born, and he called her: O mother.
depictionNotes: Umm Ayman (Barakah), an Abyssinian woman, is shown with deep dark brown skin, and the Arabs of Makkah and Madina around her with warm brown skin, every woman's hair covered. The Prophet ﷺ is never shown, at any age: where he is present the picture leaves him out and a soft breeze passes over it. His mother, his grandfather, his uncle, Fatimah, Abu Bakr and Umar are shown. The facts come from Sahih Muslim, al-Bukhari, Ibn Sa'd's Tabaqat and the Shia collections named in the notes. Her birth year is not known; the year used to place this game on the home page is a guess. Pictures are AI-generated.
coverAlt: Umm Ayman leads two camels home to Makkah under the stars.
